title: The Core Analysis Brief
summary: Analyse is now the heart of YTIntel: one YouTube link runs an ordered 17-part research brief from source facts through transcript, replay, frames, packaging, channel context, your remake, vault memory and export.
discord_changes: One link now builds the full 17-section Core Analysis Brief in the exact research order.
Visible parallel task telemetry shows source, transcript, replay, visual, packaging, remake, vault and verification progress.
Analyses, hooks and packages now bank into persistent niche/subniche memory with Markdown, PDF and transcript export.
changes: Rebuilt Analyse around the Monday Brief order: Strip, Summary, Takeaways, Hook, Re-hooks, Payoffs, Most Replayed, Steal/Do Not Copy, Visuals, Motion, Audio, Packaging, Channel Context, Make It Yours, Vault, Cross-check/Export and Full Transcript.
Added a visible Analysis Room whose percentage only moves as real parallel evidence tasks resolve; it shows task telemetry rather than private model reasoning.
Added de-duplicated overall and per-minute WPM, longest-silence detection, transcript-wide beat sampling and source-backed hook/re-hook/payoff receipts.
Added public storyboard key frames at replay peaks plus honest storyboard visual-change cut/motion proxies and public caption-coded music/SFX evidence.
Added thumbnail pixel measurements, possible title-test detection against the channel feed, title/hook keyword extraction and promise-versus-delivery checks.
Added channel-context scanning for recent channel-relative hits and same/adjacent title angles.
Added brand-rule-aware source-specific remake directions through the existing deep Packaging path; when cloud deep reasoning is unavailable, generic filler remains refused.
Added persistent analysis vault, hook bank and package bank tables with row-level security plus niche, subniche, target-audience and brand-rule profile fields.
Added hook-bank side-by-side comparison, deterministic timestamp/quote/metric cross-checks, full Markdown export, print/save-PDF support and full transcript copy/download.
Focused the visible product around Analyse, Competitors and Vault while retiring redundant top-level tools now incorporated into the Core Analysis Brief.
Bumped the PWA shell and dynamic late-layer loader to v0.30.0.
why_it_matters: The product now matches the core promise in the brief: a creator can hand YTIntel one video and receive a source-grounded research artifact designed to replace watching and manually dissecting the entire upload, while weak or unavailable evidence is labelled instead of invented.
